recipe.visualDefinition: A high-grain, warm-toned photograph of a woman seated at a multi-paneled vanity mirror in a dressing room. The composition features a back-view of the subject in the foreground and her reflection in the background, creating a sense of intimacy and introspection through a hazy, desaturated pink and brown palette.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject and reflection creating a dual-perspective narrative
Heavy film grain texture unifying the foreground and background
Geometric mirror frames slicing the composition into vertical segments
Warm, low-key lighting contrasting with bright white typographic elements
coreInvariants: Heavy, visible color noise and film grain
Desaturated magenta and sepia color cast
Back-view of the subject as the primary foreground anchor

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is seated in the lower right foreground, occupying approximately 40% of the frame, while her reflection is centered in the mid-ground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The woman's back and the white chair in the lower right corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large display text in the top left, moves down to the reflection, then follows the subject's back to the secondary text in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with mirror reflections, clothing, and furniture.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted dusty rose and magenta tones in the skin and clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark sepia and charcoal in the shadows and hair.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for the typography and highlights on the chair.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a compressed value range, leaning towards mid-tones and highlights with crushed blacks.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: High-contrast transitional serif and monolinear geometric sans
letterConstructionRules: Display text uses heavy italics with sharp serifs and high stroke contrast
Secondary text uses wide-tracked, slanted sans-serif characters
Graphic device includes a thin, white monolinear abstract scribble or signature-like path
characterSpecificRedesigns: Small caps or wide-spaced lowercase for secondary titling
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for the name paired with a minimalist, airy sans-serif for the title.
graphicDevices: Thin white monolinear line art resembling a loose, gestural scribble or star-like path behind the bottom text.

preserve: Italic angle of the display text
avoid: Modernist sans-serif for the main name

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, traditional serif feel of the display text.
Provides the geometric, wide-tracked feel for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A grainy, 1970s film-style photograph of a woman with dark hair sitting in a dressing room. She is seen from behind, wearing a patterned robe, looking into a triptych vanity mirror. The lighting is warm and hazy with a strong pink/magenta color cast and heavy analog noise.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, bold italicized serif text in white with a thin black drop shadow in the top left. In the bottom right, add a thin white gestural line drawing, and overlay wide-tracked, slanted sans-serif text in white.

verificationChecks: Is the film grain texture prominent across the entire image?
Does the display text have a distinct 70s-era italic serif quality?
Is the color palette restricted to warm pinks, browns, and whites?

adjustableVariables: Saturation of the magenta color cast
Tracking width of the secondary text
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is legible against the grainy background.
Ensure the reflection in the mirror aligns logically with the subject.
Verify the white graphic device in the bottom right doesn't obscure the text.
Confirm the overall mood is nostalgic and intimate.
recipe.reuseFormula: Analog Film Grain + Triptych Mirror Composition + Italic Serif Typography + Dusty Rose Palette
